name: DLA Crystal Growth
description: Physics Lab — real Brownian walkers (up to 64k particles in the group-1 sim ring) wander until they touch the crystal, then freeze into fractal dendrites. Click to plant seeds, hold to paint them; Branch Angle snaps steps onto a hex lattice for snowflake arms; bass surges stickiness. graph · 3 passes · sim ring.

params.name: Walker Speed
params.description: Steps per frame and step length of every walker

params.name: Attraction Strength
params.description: Drift toward the cursor; also widens the seed brush

params.name: Stickiness
params.description: Chance a walker freezes on contact (bass adds a surge)

params.name: Branch Angle
params.description: 0 = isotropic dendrites, 1 = six-fold hex-lattice snowflake arms
